install: set -euo pipefail; [ -x .venv/bin/python ] || python3 -m venv .venv; .venv/bin/python -m pip install --no-input --upgrade pip; .venv/bin/python -m pip install --no-input -r backend/requirements.txt; npm --prefix frontend ci --no-audit --no-fund; if [ -f "$HOME/.bashrc" ]; then sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc"; fi; VENV_PATH_LINE="export PATH=\"$PWD/.venv/bin:\$PATH\""; grep -qxF "$VENV_PATH_LINE" "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || echo "$VENV_PATH_LINE" >> "$HOME/.bashrc"
